experiment.title: MMB Threshold NMS Calibration
experiment.objective: Test whether score-threshold and overlap suppression calibration reduces false positives in dense scenes under the same VISO protocol.

notes: Always start with devsample before any full-dataset run on VISO.
Keep seed set and evaluation protocol identical to v1 for comparability.
Single controlled variable: threshold and overlap suppression calibration.
